gates.gate: G2 PK and count convention scans
gates.guards: PK programs use log-scale geometric statistics, counts use distinct participants, and the drafter's number check has a self-test (pattern scans; they do not show where a reported number comes from)
gates.evidence: per-program scans: 28 of 28 R programs pass (28 found by content, committed floor 28: they call pkstats(), use geomean or geocv, assign a Geo Mean or Geo CV% column, take exp(mean()) or 10^mean(), or fit a model whose formula is not written in code, whose right-hand side names a dose, treatment, period, sequence or formulation term, or that reads ADPP); comments are ignored and strings are never read as code. R: a name is log-derived when assigned from log() (log10, log2) or a log-derived name, a column taken from a data frame by name (d$x, d[["x"]], pull(d, x)) counts as that column only, and exp() or 10^ ends log-derivation; in 8 geomean/geocv assignments and 37 Geo Mean/Geo CV% columns, every branch (if/else, ifelse, if_else, coalesce, case_when, pmin, pmax) inside display wrappers such as sprintf() and round() is NA, a geometric name or function of the file, or exactly exp() of a log-scale mean (mean(), coef() or similar of a natural-log value; 10^ of a log10 one), for a CV exactly [100*]sqrt(exp(V) - 1) or sqrt(expm1(V)) with V a natural-log variance (a name assigned only NA is not geometric); 8 models have a log-derived response (a formula not written in code fails); and each program uses log() (or log10/log2) or calls pkstats() (pkstats() passes the same rules). SAS twin at the same path: every geomean (round() unwrapped) is missing, a geometric name, or exp() of a PROC MEANS mean of a natural-log variable (10** for log10), every geocv missing, a geometric-CV name or [100*]sqrt(exp(V)-1) with V a natural-log variance or squared SD (a variable assigned only missing is not geometric), every MODEL response log-derived; 1 twin calls %pkstats (the macro passes the same rules), 23 back-transform their own such mean in the same base, 4 model-only twins fit a MODEL. Static check: nothing is run, and log(x + c) counts as log-scale; distinct-participant counting in 164 programs; drafter number-validation self-test present (5)
